_note: Ground-truth query set. 'difficulty' tiers per design.md: exact = echoes the tool's own description vocabulary (sanity floor); paraphrase = same intent with little or no shared vocabulary (the case semantic matching should win); ambiguous = plausibly matches 2+ catalog tools, so a dip here is informative rather than a routing bug. Each query has exactly one expected [server, tool], so mean recall_at_k over the set is the method's recall@k.
